definition_of_done: Give the authenticated Sign out control an explicit stable class and keep its visible text label at desktop and mobile widths.
Use a dark or transparent control background with WCAG AA text contrast against the graphite top bar in default, hover, active, and disabled states.
Provide a clearly visible keyboard focus indicator and retain at least a 44 by 44 pixel mobile target.
Keep the mobile top bar within a 390 pixel viewport by hiding lower-priority persona text rather than the Sign out label.
Preserve logout behavior and accessible icon semantics.
Add focused source assertions for label visibility, contrast styling, focus-visible styling, and mobile target sizing.
forbidden_scope: authorization, persistence, command, navigation, or unrelated layout changes
hiding the Sign out label at any required viewport
task.objective: Repair the blocking Sign out contrast, label, focus, and mobile-target accessibility defect from independent design review.
task.title: Repair QuoteRivet Sign out accessibility
